text:
noah: FYI 0-min hosted demo request from BioFirst. They want a 3-4 minute live walkthrough with a burst around 110 QPS. Baseline < 8 QPS. Can we support with a hosted scoped key?
trina: Are these short generates or streaming chat?
noah: Short generates, avg 100 tokens, 5 concurrent demo clients.
eli-sales: Procurement wants a single-line security summary + worst-case cost.
devops-bot: Reminder: scoped keys require origin constraints and explicit TTL. Non-admins cannot extend TTL post-creation.
ops: We can do a scoped key with qps_cap=125 (buffer), token_budget=7_000_000, allow_streaming=false, origin_ips=["198.51.100.45","198.51.100.46"], expires=2026-06-15T19:30:00Z.
trina: Good — add a routing fallback to the int8 variant to avoid 429 cascades if kernels saturate.
ops: Routing rule proposal: primary redwood/opt-4b, fallback redwood/opt-4b-int8. Condition: if p95 latency > 800ms for 2 windows, route new traffic to fallback.
noah: Can you also add a dashboard panel and an alert that pages on-call if error rate jumps > 0.8%?
ops: Yes. We'll create a Grafana panel for the scoped key and an alert: 5m error rate > 0.8% OR 5m p95 latency > 1s -> rollback + page.
eli-sales: Cost calc: 110 QPS * 240s * 100 tokens = 2.64M tokens. With warmup and buffer use 7M tokens as ops suggested.
trina: Pre-warm steps: send 12 canonical prompts to ops by EOD Mon to populate KV cache. Pre-warm reduces first-request tail.
noah: Demo window and IPs: 2026-06-15T19:00:00Z->2026-06-15T19:20:00Z, IPs above. Contact for revoke: noah@redwood + demo@biofirst.com.
devops-bot: Action created: scoped_key_2120009876 by noah. Assigned to ops. SLA: same-day.
ops: Example curl for BioFirst devs (token redacted):
```
curl https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \ 
 -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_poc_xxx" \ 
 -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
 -d '{"model":"redwood/opt-4b","input":"Summarize patient summary...","max_tokens":120}'
```
eli-sales: Security blurb for procurement: "Scoped API keys are single-purpose, IP-restricted, short TTL, and revocable. All requests are logged and tied to key fingerprint; logs retained 30 days by default. For additional isolation we offer Dedicated pools or Private deployments."
noah: Can we get the key by EOD Mon so we can do a smoke test 15min before demo?
ops: Will provision and share in #sales-secure. Disabling streaming per request.
devops-bot: Scoped key provisioned and shared to #sales-secure (token redacted).
eli-sales: Sent procurement note and worst-case cost estimate to BioFirst.
noah: Thanks all 7. Standby engineer is ops. If anything changes Ill update this thread.
